title: Split `podman image trust` manpage
body: The `podman image trust set` and `podman image trust show` commands presently share a single manpage (`podman-image-trust.1.md.in`). This is not correct - all commands should have their own manpage. Split into two manpages, one for each subcommand, retaining the current manpage to list subcommands (similar to `podman manifest` or `podman container`).
